title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.19752v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-horizon policies trained with reinforcement learning can still achieve high return through inefficient interactions, while rare efficient behaviors discovered during training may be forgotten. We argue that temporal efficiency itself provides a source of self-supervision for reinforcement learning. We introduce Temporal Self-Imitation Learning (TSIL), a reinforcement learning framework that mines temporally efficient successful trajectories generated during learning and converts them into reusable supervision for future policy improvement. TSIL progressively refines learning using configuration-conditioned adaptive temporal targets derived from fast successful trajectories, while preserving and replaying efficient behaviors through efficiency-weighted self-imitation learning. translated_abstract: 使用强化学习训练的长时程策略仍然可以通过低效的交互获得高回报，而训练过程中发现的罕见高效行为却可能被遗忘。我们认为，时间效率本身可以为强化学习提供一种自监督信号来源。我们提出了时间自模仿学习，这是一个强化学习框架，它挖掘学习过程中产生的具有时间效率的成功轨迹，并将其转化为可复用的监督信号，用于未来的策略改进。TSIL利用从快速成功轨迹中导出的基于配置条件的自适应时间目标来逐步优化学习过程，同时通过效率加权的自模仿学习来保存和重放高效行为。在涵盖机器人操作和交互式导航的30个长时程任务中，TSIL持续提升了任务成功率和学习效率。
tldr: 提出了时间自模仿学习（TSIL）框架，通过挖掘训练中时间高效的成功轨迹并将其转化为可复用的自监督信号，在30个机器人长时程任务上持续提升任务成功率与学习效率。
en_tdlr: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning (TSIL) mines temporally efficient successful trajectories during training and converts them into reusable self-supervision, consistently improving task success rates and learning efficiency across 30 long-horizon robotic tasks.
